content.text:
`cafe-chairs` now returns `status = "rejected"` with the reason "over the credit or order limit", and all 8 visible tests pass.

The cause was in `src/steps/combine-checks/index.mjs`. The two parallel checks each write their answers under their own branch (`runs.check-stock.*` and `runs.check-credit.*`), and combine-checks copied only the stock answers. So approval never saw `creditOk`, the reject rule never matched, and the order fell through to approve. The order's 1167 total is over Hill Street Cafe's 800 order limit, so the credit check was right all along.

I changed the step to also copy `creditOk` and `headroom` from `runs.check-credit` to plain keys, the same way it already handles the stock answers.
